description: This file defines an internal sealed class CachingSiloAddressCodec that implements caching and serialization/deserialization logic for SiloAddress objects within Orleans. It includes methods for reading and writing raw addresses, managing caches, and performing periodic cleanup to optimize performance.

classes.name: CachingSiloAddressCodec
classes.description: Serializer for SiloAddress that uses caching to avoid repeated encoding and decoding, with internal management of a private cache and a shared cache for deduplication.

methods.name: ReadRaw
methods.description: Reads a raw SiloAddress from the input, utilizing cache for optimization.

methods.name: WriteRaw
methods.description: Serializes a SiloAddress to the output, updating caches accordingly.

methods.name: PurgeStaleEntries
methods.description: Removes cache entries that haven't been seen for a specified duration.

methods.name: ReadSiloAddressInner
methods.description: Helper method to read inner details of a SiloAddress from the input.

methods.name: WriteSiloAddressInner
methods.description: Helper method to write inner details of a SiloAddress to the output.
